svg.title: View Transitions Mock Lifecycle Flow
svg.desc: Flowchart comparing the native Same-Document and Element-Scoped View Transitions lifecycle against view-transitions-mock. Starting from State A, the flow splits into two branches: Native Implementation executes all 10 steps, while view-transitions-mock skips snapshot capture, rendering pause/resume, pseudo-tree construction, and animations, executing only DOM updates and resolving the updateCallbackDone, ready, and finished promises before merging into State B.

g.text: A non-visual polyfill for Same-Document and Element-Scoped View Transitions
